decisions.reason: Fifteen minutes preserves 일각 and keeps the sentence’s meaning.
The flash striking him before the impact preserves the source’s sequence.
The source has him mutter inwardly; “thought” drops that attitude.
The tightened phrasing keeps the Mount Song condition and meaning.
SOL drops that this was a fear of death he had never experienced before.
“Do right by others” naturally conveys his understanding of 인의.
“Awaited him” keeps the sense of hardships still ahead.
The recast keeps the grandfather’s teaching and the right path.
“Pain of bones broken” preserves the injuries and reads naturally.
SOL drops the source’s image of large and small wounds etched across him.
“I don’t think so” preserves his disagreement in natural dialogue.
The source says he saw the assassin; SOL changes that action to meeting him.
The first-person phrasing matches Cheongpung’s account of whom he meets.
The source describes a low, quiet breath; SOL substitutes an unsupported slow breath.
“Erased all trace of his presence” naturally conveys 지운다.
The recast preserves the timing and the changed meaning of the repeated question.
The cleaner list keeps the biological terms and his confusion.
“Anything this bizarre” keeps the Slaughter Saint’s incredulity.
Naming Cheongpung clarifies the subject without changing the action.
터득했다 conveys mastery, which “learned” weakens.
The italicized “whole” preserves 무려’s emphasis.
The source specifies seeing with his eyes and moving with his body; SOL drops that image.
The rebirth as his own martial art remains clear and source-faithful.
The revised sentence keeps the pace and the fragrance perceptible only to him.
The recast preserves the merging techniques and their increased stealth.
The source says his presence cannot be made out; SOL shifts this to his location.
“Stab” conveys the puncturing sound of 푹.
“Properly noticed” preserves 제대로 and the chaotic fighting.
The source says he blended in naturally; SOL drops that manner.
The recast keeps both roles and the Temporary Strength Pill’s effect.
The cleaner word order preserves the warped space and immense force.
The sentence keeps both attackers and the blind-spot approach.
The fragment keeps the urgent realization that he is too late.
“Whispered it to him” keeps the source’s personification.
The source’s regretful judgment that this was not enough must remain.
“He hated to admit it” adds reluctance absent from the source.
The recast preserves Cheongpung’s unwavering faith in Jin Taekyung.
“Blinding flash” conveys the dazzling light and keeps the destination clear.
The sentence preserves the Black Ghost shielding against the force.
Dropping “of light” avoids redundancy without changing 섬광.
The shorter phrasing retains the Black Ghost at the end of his path.
The recast keeps the strike’s single line toward the figure.
“The moment” preserves the source’s precise timing for the shiver.
SOL changes the image: the source says heat cannot erase the shiver, not that space vanishes into heat.
“At the same moment” preserves the simultaneity.
“More precisely” preserves the correction to what the fire dragon swallowed.
SOL drops the image of the flames dyeing everything around them.
“Set more coldly” is awkward and shifts the source’s image of his face turning cold.
The tense change preserves his pallor and clouding eyes.
The recast keeps the blood loss and his effort to watch the fire.
It preserves the information’s certainty and that only he can hear it.
“That strike” makes the referent explicit without changing the meaning.
The source has him trying to perceive the situation; SOL changes it to understanding what had happened.
The source leaves the object unstated; SOL adds “it.”
The recast retains both the holographic windows and the System warnings.
“Beneath him” clarifies the legs giving way without changing the event.
투둑 is not specifically a crackling sound; SOL changes the sound effect.
“Rose to its feet” preserves the monster standing up.
“Controlling his body” preserves the instinct’s hold over him.
The revised subject keeps the dry sound of his footsteps.
The brief question keeps the source’s puzzled beat.
The combined sentence preserves the failed senses and darkness.
The source allows only a very small sound; SOL changes it to plural sounds and adds superlative emphasis.
Screams and steel scraping against steel preserve the remembered sounds.
The source describes a familiar, nostalgic feeling; SOL recasts it as something he missed.
SOL drops the emphasis that the thing was utterly familiar.
“Senses gradually sharpened” naturally preserves their growing vividness.
“Swept his hand out” preserves the forceful hand movement.
The source says his fingertips touched the shoulder; SOL changes the action to his hand closing on it.
“Your subordinates” explicitly preserves 속하들 and the speaker’s deference.
이미 자라난 means already grown; “newly grown” adds a recent change.
